spans.text: Every morning, when I wake up, the first thought I have is...
"I wonder if I still have my body."
I take a look at my body and think to myself...
Thank goodness I have a body in which I can move freely!
Most importantly, I'm still alive – I can keep living with him.
It'll be such a shame to die. Living like this makes me the happiest.
And so I live my days...fervently praying that I can always be happy.
